item.title: Navi 0.3.1（20261121.032133）
item.description:
Ash 改名为 Navi。新版换了应用标识，没法从 Ash 里直接更新：点「了解更多」下载 Navi，拖进「应用程序」后打开一次，它会接过 Navi 的设置、数据和登录项，并把旧的 Ash.app 移到废纸篓。

  • chore(mac): 版本号 0.3.1
  • fix(ui): unify branded app states and crash handoff
  • fix(mac): preserve button gesture order confirmed by live click traces
  • feat(macos): add branded restart and offline transition
  • fix(mac): retract speculative input routing and add isolated click tracing
  • fix: protect user previews from agent service cleanup
  • fix(web): use S for conversation timeline and add recall toolbar icon
  • fix: reuse retained previews and allow closing during task runs
  • fix(mac): preserve mouse event order across input method handling
  • fix(labels,composer): 长标签收在小块里、分支名不再被截括号
  • fix: keep ready task previews open across continued runs
  • ui(composer): 工作目录和 base 分支挪进新建卡片底排
  • ui(composer): 工作目录和 base 分支常驻在新建卡片下面；标签编辑器补上通用样式
